head.h1: Canape Catering in Dubai — Prices, Formats and What You Get

opening_paragraph: Canape catering in Dubai from myCHEF starts at AED 700 per person — bite-size food designed for standing receptions, quoted to your exact headcount, menu and service level. A vetted private chef and a service team cook, plate, pass and clear on site, so you can host the room instead of running the kitchen. Send your date, guest numbers and venue, and during our published business hours you will have an itemised proposal back promptly.

new_paragraphs: It includes everything from menu design to the last tray cleared: a chef-built selection of hot and cold canapes, the staff to pass or display them, and full setup and cleanup. As the team coordinating your booking, we scope each brief around how the room moves: guests standing, mingling, a drink already in one hand, so every bite is one clean mouthful that needs no plate or knife. A typical reception runs 6 to 12 pieces per guest across savoury and sweet, adjusted for whether canapes are the whole evening or a prelude to dinner. Your quote covers the canape menu, a vetted chef, service or drop-off delivery, on-site finishing and the clear-down. When you hire canape catering in Dubai through myCHEF you get one team and one point of contact for the food, not a patchwork of vendors — which is what separates genuine catering services in Dubai from a tray delivered cold to your door.

add_block.new_heading: Canape catering for weddings, corporate events and parties
new_paragraphs: Canapes suit any occasion where people are on their feet and talking, which is most of them. For weddings and engagements, a passed canape hour bridges the ceremony and the seated meal and keeps guests fed while photographs run long. For corporate catering — launches, networking evenings, board receptions and gallery openings — canapes let 50 or 200 people eat without breaking a conversation, which is why corporate canape catering in Dubai is our busiest reception format. For private canape party catering, from a milestone birthday to a villa gathering, the same kitchen scales up or down. We handle canape catering for events across every size, and because the food is designed to be eaten standing, the guest count is limited by your venue, not by seating. Tell us the occasion and we match the menu, the pace of service and the team to it.

add_block.new_heading: What is on a canape menu?
new_paragraphs: A canape menu is built in three movements — cold, hot and sweet — and designed to your cuisine, budget and dietary needs. Cold canapes might include beef tartare on toasted brioche, smoked salmon blinis, burrata with heritage tomato, or tuna tataki spoons. Hot canapes come straight from the chef's pass: mini wagyu sliders, tempura prawns, truffled arancini, lamb kofta with labneh. The sweet canape finish — pistachio financiers, dark-chocolate tarts, saffron panna cotta shots — is often built by our pastry chef Matteo Moretti. Every canape menu in Dubai we design can be made fully halal, and we run vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and nut-free versions of most pieces without a separate, lesser menu. Ask for the canape food styles you have in mind and we will send options at a few price points.

add_block.new_heading: The full canapé menu, section by section
new_paragraphs: This is the working dish bank the chefs build a canapé reception from. It runs in the order the evening does: something already on the tables as guests arrive, a cold round, a hot round, the handheld and bowl food that carries a longer night, then sweet. Nothing below is a fixed package. You mark what your room wants, the chef says what is worth serving that week and what the venue can physically support, and the agreed list goes into the written quote before anything is confirmed.

Counts and minimums: a pre-dinner reception needs 6 to 8 pieces per guest, and 10 to 12 when the canapés are the meal. Bookings start at 10 guests, or 20 for a stationed display served buffet-style, with a minimum order value of AED 900. Small party catering in Dubai — a villa terrace of 15, a boardroom of 12 — draws on the same bank as a 200-guest launch; what changes is the piece count, the format and the size of the team. For an address outside the emirate — Sharjah, Ajman or Abu Dhabi — send it with your enquiry and we tell you before you commit whether it can be served from the Dubai network and what the travel adds.

One structural note: the charcuterie line is halal and pork-free by default. Turkey ham, turkey bacon, pastrami and beef or chicken sausage carry the boards and the one-bite sandwiches instead of pork. That is not a reduced version of the category, it is how the good kitchens here work. Premium-tier pieces — caviar, foie gras, wagyu, lobster, oysters — are sourced to order, so the chef confirms availability and cost on the quote instead of assuming either.

Dietary requirements are settled before the menu is signed off, not on the day. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event: the requirement goes to the licensed culinary partner, who assesses the ingredients and the preparation environment and confirms what can be provided before the menu is signed off. The vegetarian and vegan sections below are separate blocks with their own hot and cold pieces, not one token item added to a meat menu.
Arrival bites and table nibbles
Set out before service starts, so the room has something in reach while the first drinks go round. These are priced separately from the canapé count.

The round that decides whether guests stop looking for dinner. Lamb and beef carry it; the fryer items go out first because they have the shortest window. None of that removes a single item below: the arancini, the tempura, the cigars and the churros are fried in the licensed partner kitchen, carried hot in insulated cabinets and re-crisped on site at the finishing station, which is how a canapé fryer round reaches a Dubai reception in practice.

Live and interactive stations

Quoted per station, per person, and each one needs its own chef standing at it. The equipment sits with the assigned culinary partner; what decides which station you get is the room. The live carvery is the one that goes everywhere — no flame, no fuel, no extraction — so it stands in a villa dining room, on a tower balcony where building rules bar every grill and barbecue whatever the fuel, on a yacht deck where no extra gas cylinder may come aboard, and on a public beach where nothing fired is permitted at all. It needs a hot-holding plan and a carving lamp, not a permit, which is why it is the station we build a difficult venue around. Anything with charcoal or a cylinder is the opposite case: yes outdoors on a villa plot, and no gas at all on a rooftop, where the UAE Fire and Life Safety Code (Table 11.1) keeps LPG cylinders off any roof or terrace and a tower above 90 m cannot take LPG up there by any route — so a rooftop reception runs the induction and plancha stations, which cook the same list. In the desert the blocker is enclosure rather than fuel: charcoal and the shawarma spit are a straight yes in the open air and barred inside a tent or an enclosed majlis, so the charcoal station stands outside it, and the ash and coals leave with the caterer, which Dubai Municipality enforces against us rather than you.
Taqueria Station: tortillas pressed and grilled in front of guests, carne asada, chicken confit, beef cheek, tuna ceviche, sauces mixed by the guest.
Live Carvery Station: honey miso glazed roasts, sautéed greens, butternut pumpkin and truffle celeriac purées.

The canapé builder — bases against fillings

Volume receptions are usually easier to build the way the trade builds them: pick a base, pick a filling, and one of each equals one canapé. It is the fastest way to price a large order and to keep a vegetarian count exactly where you want it.
Bases, standard: tartlet, crostini, blini, stick, cucumber shell, short crust, toast, cracker, skewer.
Bases, special: lettuce bed, bell pepper bed, spoon, glass, plate, brioche, beetroot spinach bun, thyme shortbread, vol au vent.
Fillings, standard vegetarian: basil mozzarella cherry tomato, beetroot hummus, creamy mushroom, labneh olive, green peas and mint hummus, herbed potato balls, teriyaki tofu, wilted spinach and feta.
Fillings, standard: tuna corn, smoked chicken and rocket, spicy cilantro chicken tikka, pimento devilled egg, turkey ham honey mustard.

Fillings, special: caprese with fresh mozzarella balls, black fig goat cheese and rocca, truffle scented mushrooms, chicken bouchée, chicken and leeks quichettes, smoked chicken and apricot, butter chicken, beef in Arabic, Thai, Indian or minced preparations.

add_block.new_heading: Styling, dietary needs and event logistics
new_paragraphs: Beyond the food itself, canape catering is a logistics exercise, and it is the part that quietly decides whether a reception feels calm or chaotic. We plan the flow of trays so hot canapes reach guests hot, position a discreet finishing station out of sightlines, and staff the room so guests are not left waiting and no tray sits out too long. Dietary requirements are handled properly: tell us about allergies and observances and every affected canape is labelled, tracked and made safely, not guessed. For venues without a working kitchen — a villa terrace, a rooftop, a yacht deck — the chef brings the mobile setup needed to finish on site. This attention to service is what luxury canape catering in Dubai means in practice: not gold leaf for its own sake, but a room where the food does not become something the host has to think about.

add_block.new_heading: Planning canape catering step by step
new_paragraphs: Send your date, guest count and venue — your proposal arrives.
Book canape catering about 2 weeks ahead off-peak, and 6 weeks ahead between November and March.
Confirm what goes on the menu 7 days out, once the count settles.
Ask for special diets up front; plates are planned, not improvised inside 48 hours .
Check loading and access details; allow 2 hours of setup on site.
Plan on roughly 3 hours of service, and add 5% VAT to the total.

new_paragraphs: How much does canape catering cost in Dubai?

Canape catering costs from AED 700 per person, with most reception menus between AED 700 and AED 950 per person depending on the pieces, ingredients and service level. Event packages start at AED 1200. Every quote is itemised by headcount and menu.
What is included in canape catering?
Included is menu design, a vetted chef, the service or delivery team, on-site setup and cleanup. You choose the canape menu and format; we bring everything needed to cook, pass and clear on the day.
How many canapes should I order per guest?

Order 6 to 8 canapes per guest for a pre-dinner reception, and 10 to 12 per guest when canapes replace a meal. We confirm the exact count with you based on the length of the event and whether food follows.
Can you cater a private canape party at home?

Yes — home canape catering is one of our most requested formats. A private canape chef and team bring the mobile setup to your villa or apartment and finish everything on site, so your kitchen stays yours.
Do you offer halal, vegan and allergy-friendly canapes?

Yes, the full canape menu can be made halal, and we run vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free and nut-free versions of most canapes. Tell us your dietary needs and every affected piece is labelled and prepared safely.
Is canape catering good for corporate events?

Corporate canape catering is ideal for launches, networking evenings and receptions, because guests can eat and talk without sitting down. We scale from an intimate boardroom to a 200-guest reception with the same team.
How do I hire canape catering near me in Dubai?

To hire canape catering, send your date, headcount and venue and we reply with an itemised proposal, usually within one business day. We cover every district in Dubai, so "near me" is wherever your event is.
Which is the best canape catering option for my budget?

The best and most affordable option depends on your format: drop-off canape catering is the most economical per head, while passed service suits weddings and premium events. We will recommend the right fit for your budget.
For canape catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
